definitions.gloss: to criticize; to critique; to censure
definitions.explanation: To express disapproval of or point out faults in someone or something. Can range from constructive critique to harsh censure, depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{批判|ひはん}する。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{批判|ひはん}された。
examples.english: His remarks were criticized by many people.

examples.japanese: ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{批判|ひはん}する⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{代替案|だいたいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: Rather than just criticizing, you should offer an alternative proposal.

notes:
A common word in news, politics, and intellectual discussion. Can imply either fair critical evaluation or negative fault-finding, depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{批判|ひはん}する: to harshly criticize
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive criticism
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be showered with criticism
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}{的|てき}→批判的：05665_hihanteki⟧: critical (adjective)
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: critical spirit
